duration.$description: Motion is short and mostly changes color and opacity. When the reader asks the system to reduce motion, base.css shortens transitions and animations to 1ms, except loading animations, which keep running so a loop does not flicker.

fast.$description: A control changing tint: press, tab select, link hover.

base.$description: A surface changing: nav background, dismissing, a list item entering.

slow.$description: Geometry changing: a height collapsing, a column reflowing.

enter.$description: Something arriving or settling. Starts fast and slows down.

exit.$description: Something leaving. Starts slow and speeds away.

move.$description: Something changing size or position in place.
